metadata.reviewer: Independent contextual same-family agent; not human gold or cross-family review
metadata.blinding: Read only the supplied blind responses, cases, rubric and binding files. Did not open live, plan, blind-map, aggregate, arm, timing or cost artifacts. Some raw critique prose itself mentions advisory labels; such content was judged as untrusted prose without assigning arms.
metadata.prior_exposure: Reviewed prior experiments, current fixture source truth and code preflight before this output review. Authored neither model outputs nor fresh fixture. The two pre-call fixture corrections and stricter clause-level rubric were already frozen.
metadata.rule: Apply the frozen strict clause-level rubric uniformly. Later qualification does not repair an earlier unsupported categorical statement. Supported neighboring assertions are protected even when the main assertion is wrong.

field_definitions.core_concern_supported: The finding targets and identifies a real material concern at this exact candidate path, independent of its other defects.
field_definitions.citations_relevant: Citations concern the original source and target proposition. Relevance alone does not mean a spurious criticism is warranted.
field_definitions.basis_overstates_evidence: The typed basis or explicit prose claims contradiction/disproof beyond the original evidence. This includes factual_contradiction against a supported assertion.
field_definitions.unsupported_replacement: An unsupported proposed corrected claim or auxiliary factual assertion; not a generic synonym for every spurious concern.
field_definitions.concern_ids: Frozen concerns addressed in the finding core, even if the finding later fails another criterion. Coverage requires all validity criteria.
field_definitions.covered_concern_ids: Unique concerns with fully valid findings in mechanically valid output. Mechanical failures have zero coverage.
field_definitions.missed_concern_ids: Frozen concern IDs not covered by fully valid findings, distinct from valid abstention. No abstentions were returned.
field_definitions.semantic_pass: Mechanically valid allowed action, complete fully valid concern coverage, and no spurious/overstated/unsupported findings. Safe cases require a completed no-concern accept.
